name: genshin-mods
description: A Claude Code plugin of mods: five under one band above the prompt (the next steps, the cache and usage with a one-click handoff, recording mode, a goal's task list and a question before editing a file another session just changed) a delegation guard that nudges a run of lookups toward a haiku agent, a disk-scan guard that refuses a Bash scan from a root or a home folder, and a whole-index guard that refuses a git command over the whole index while another session shares the checkout.
author: Jimmy Chen
